purpose: Replace the Q4_K_M plus MTP2 repeated-token context diagnostic with directly measured three-class real-content HTTP decode and TTFT points, using a fresh matched MTP0 target oracle and two fresh MTP2 server attempts.

frozen_identity.hardware: one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GiB, GPU0, TP1

run_order: one fresh MTP0 server for the target-output oracle
freeze and commit the MTP0 result before speculative attempts
two separate fresh MTP2 servers over the same ordered 18 cases
per_request_gates: usage prompt count equals the exact submitted depth
cached_tokens equals zero and llama cache_n is zero when reported
128 returned token IDs and a length stop
100 timestamped output events and 99 inter-token intervals

arm_gates.mtp0: all 18 request gates and the objective canary battery pass; output hashes become the sole frozen target oracle
arm_gates.mtp2: all 18 request gates, objective canaries, positive draft/accepted counters, and exact 128-token equality to the frozen MTP0 case at every published cell

aggregation.per_depth_decode: median of the three class conventional 99-interval decode rates
aggregation.per_depth_ttft: median of the three directly measured class TTFT values
aggregation.across_mtp2_attempts: median of the two fresh-server per-depth medians; retain both samples and relative range

publication_policy.passed_cell: may replace only the same Q4_K_M plus Q4_0 MTP2 TP1 context/TTFT cell and must retain fixture scope and sample counts
publication_policy.failed_or_divergent_cell: preserve and quarantine with no speed publication
not_authorized: transfer to another quantization, topology, MTP depth, KV type, graph mode, runtime, or model revision
